tooltips.geometry_text: Classroom geometry defines acoustics and sight lines. Rectangular classrooms favor direct instruction, while circular or 'L' shapes create natural niches for collaborative work without distractions.
tooltips.zones_text: In Education 5.0, the classroom is not a single block. It is divided into 'micro-environments' (zones) that allow different teams to work on different projects simultaneously.
tooltips.acoustics_text: Noise is the #1 enemy of learning. 'Premium' finishes include sound-absorbing panels and technical floors that reduce reverberation, increasing information retention by up to 30%.
tooltips.capacity_text: We calculate tables for 8 students to encourage 'Learning Cells'. Groups larger than 8 dilute participation; groups smaller than 4 limit diversity of ideas.
